patthana9.6:1.1: na sahetukaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sahetuko na kusalo dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā: vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā. na sahetukaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na ahetuko na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca sahetukā khandhā. na sahetukaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sahetuko na kusalo ca na ahetuko na kusalo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:
patthana9.6:2.1: tīṇi. na ahetukaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na ahetuko na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana9.6:3.1: na sahetukaṃ na kusalañca na ahetukaṃ na kusalañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sahetuko na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana9.6:5.1: na sahetukaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sahetuko na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana9.6:6.1: na ahetukaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na ahetuko na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
